ruleDefinitions.name: IE Change Domain Zone
ruleDefinitions.description: Hides the file extension through modification of the registry Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Internet\\ Settings\\\\ZoneMap\\\\Domains\\\\.*") AND  NOT ((Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)" OR Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)" OR Details = "\(Empty\)"))
